title: did_webvh group: a member without AppDataUpdate blocks record changes, revocation included
description: Found in mimid-4lp4.2 (docs/didwebvh-mls-rs.md on branch didwebvh-mlsrs; test an_mls_rs_member_without_app_data_update_blocks_record_changes). mimid adds a member whose leaf does not list the AppDataUpdate proposal type (e.g. stock mls-rs) to a group that carries the did_webvh_heads component. Afterwards OpenMLS refuses every Commit that changes the record (UnsupportedProposalType; RFC 9420 §12.2, mls-extensions-11 §4.7): no new did_webvh user, no device with a newer log, no revocation, unless the same Commit removes that member. Options for Mark: (a) refuse such a member in a did_webvh group (Member::commit and the hub); (b) write AppDataUpdate into required_capabilities proposal_types when the record is set (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.33 dropped required_capabilities); (c) have Member::commit remove such members automatically in a revocation Commit; (d) leave it and document it. Draft side: feedback item 31.
notes: Decided by Mark 2026-11-19: remove them on revocation. Allow members without AppDataUpdate in did:webvh rooms; when a Commit must change the record (revocation, adding a new did:webvh user) and some members' capabilities lack AppDataUpdate, the same Commit also removes those members (mls-extensions-11 §4.7: a member removed by the Commit need not support it). They can rejoin later. Being built.
close_reason: 7346e31 (branch appdata-removal): Member::commit removes members lacking AppDataUpdate in a Commit that changes the did_webvh record (also the Update-proposal fallback); reported as removed_without_app_data_update (CommitBundle, CommitSummary) and CommitDetail::did_webvh_removes_without_app_data_update; hub authorizes those Removes without room-policy capability only for leaves lacking 0x0008 in a member Commit whose record AppDataUpdate actually changes the record. Details: decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.37. Tests: didwebvh_mls_rs.rs (revocation, Update fallback, new user + rejoin, no record change), hub_didwebvh.rs (4 new). Docs: didwebvh-mls-rs.md, feedback item 31, Limitations.
